lines: Note: Brookline Bancorp is accounting acquirer. FY2021-FY2024 = Brookline standalone. FY2025 onwards = combined Beacon entity (merger effective Sept 1, 2025).
Trajectory: Standalone DECLINING (2021-2024) → Merger SCALE EXPANSION (2025) → OPTIMIZATION phase (2026). 11.5pp efficiency gap is primary 2026 KPI.

The standalone Brookline entity delivered record net income of $115.4M ($1.48 EPS) in FY2021 in a stable rate environment. FY2022 showed NIM peak at 3.67% but modest earnings decline to $109.7M. The PCSB Bank acquisition (Q1 2023, +$2.3B assets) triggered $25.5M credit loss provisions, collapsing Q1 2023 net income to $7.6M; full-year 2023 fell 31.7% to $75.0M ($0.85 EPS). FY2024 deteriorated further to $68.7M ($0.77 EPS) at the NIM trough of 3.06% [E-048].

FY2025 reflects the combined Beacon entity from September 1, 2025: NII surged 52.6% to $503.1M; NIM recovered to 3.56%; net income rose 31.4% to $90.3M (four months combined). Q1 2026 revealed integration headwinds — operating EPS $0.70 (GAAP $0.55), $13M merger charges, loan growth below plan — but CEO Perrault characterized headwinds as 'not structural in nature' [E-048].

narrative.scqa_md:
Beacon Bank is a $22.2B in assets regional bank regulated by FDIC with 2,000 employees. A 11.5% multi-year growth rate and a trajectory the analyst classifies as stable give it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-002, E-049]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.9/5. The deepest capability gap is Fraud Investigation & Response at 2.1/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-058, E-061]. Next is Complaint Management at 2.3/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-064, E-065].

Third is Compensation Alignment at 2.7/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-008, E-003]. The issue register adds Report DOCX cites only 21 unique E-IDs. Governance spec requires ≥30. (critical severity). The issue register adds Confirmed by LLM pass: 21 unique E-IDs in report vs 85 in evidence base and 30 required… (critical severity).

Counter-signal: Network & Infrastructure Security already runs at 4.4/5 against a 3.0 peer median — a strength to build on, not rebuild. The question for Beacon Bank is whether to close Fraud Investigation & Response first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Beacon Bank should lead with Databricks (66/100 fit) against Natural Language Query (NLQ), then sequence nCino behind it. Closing Fraud Investigation & Response to the peer median alone is worth 0.9 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.
